coordinateSystem: Unity local XY, +Y up. Layer matrix includes effectParent and child transforms relative to fg center; no XZ conversion. matrix applies original UIParticle Transform autoscaling in reference canvas units; rawMatrix preserves serialized transform.

nativeRules.transformAutoscale: UIParticle.UpdateTransformScale 0x4316c3c: mode2 writes inverse(parent.lossyScale), replacing serialized zero. GetWorldScale 0x431ac38 multiplies m_Scale3D by parentScale again for baking, preserving parent visual scaling.
nativeRules.rendererVisibility: UIParticleRenderer.Set 0x4316a34 disables the ordinary renderer before Canvas BakeMesh at 0x4317b9c. Use uiRenderable, not renderer.m_Enabled.
